relationships.subject: spinal nerve transection
relationships.evidence_quote: SNT up-regulated bestrophin-1 protein expression in injured L5 and uninjured L4 DRG at day 7

relationships.subject: CaCCinh-A01
relationships.evidence_quote: intrathecal injection of the bestrophin-1 blocker CaCC<sub>inh-A01</sub> (1-10 µg) reverted SNT- or SNL-induced tactile allodynia in a concentration-dependent manner

relationships.subject: bestrophin-1
relationships.evidence_quote: Intrathecal injection of bestrophin-1 plasmid (pCMVBest) induced tactile allodynia and increased bestrophin-1 expression in DRG and spinal cord in naïve rats.

relationships.subject: CaCCinh-A01
relationships.evidence_quote: Intrathecal injection of CaCC<sub>inh-A01</sub> (10 µg) prevented SNT-induced upregulation of bestrophin-1 and GAP43 at day 7.

key_findings: SNT but not SNL durably upregulates bestrophin-1 and GAP43 in injured and uninjured DRG, with bestrophin-1 increase in CGRP+ but not IB4+ neurons
Bestrophin-1 overexpression induces allodynia; CaCCinh-A01 reverses it
